name: extract-phase-gates-transition-effects
title: Extract phase gates and non-DONE transition effects
description: Lifecycle Phase 2 step 1 of 3 (Phase 1 B-3740 + B-37e9 done). story_advance.ts is still a 944-line core handler with gate decisions, non-DONE side effects, and DONE merge cleanup tangled together. This story extracts the two lowest-risk, mutually-decoupled concerns: a phase-gates.ts gate runner (REVIEW->TEST preflight, koala validate gate, TEST->DONE done-oracle gate adapter, cwd/guard-failure adapter) and a transition-effects.ts module for non-DONE side effects (process metrics, onPhaseChange hooks, REVIEW metadata auto-commit, relatedDocs hint, next-step rendering). story_advance.ts still orchestrates inline but delegates to the new modules. Strictly behavior-preserving: gate decisions, fail-closed semantics, error wording, and evidence-write timing all unchanged. Explicitly out of scope: DONE merge/worktree cleanup (Story 3b), transition orchestrator coupling (Story 3c), and TEST semantics / legacy phase migration (Story 4). The story_advance responsibility map is PLAN-phase understanding, not a checklist deliverable.
